'''Bundil''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="XW" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was orbited by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[XQ2 Platform]] ''[[Bundil II]]'', where [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|prisoners]] from [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] were brought.<ref name="XW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although its star system is mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the planet itself remains unmentioned.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' {{1st}}
